package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspbondgoal;

/** Tests source-loader overlays from several plugin versions/classloaders. */
public final class BondGoalOverlayLifecycleTest
{
    private static final String BOND_GOAL_OVERLAY =
        "net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspbondgoal.KspBondGoalOverlay";

    private static void verify(boolean actual, String message)
    {
        if (!actual) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        // Equal binary names from different classloaders are NOT equal
        // Class objects. The stable name must match across versions.
        String staleV102 = new String(BOND_GOAL_OVERLAY);
        String staleV103 = new String(BOND_GOAL_OVERLAY);
        verify(BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnStartup(staleV102),
            "Start must remove obsolete v1.0.2 panel");
        verify(BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnStartup(staleV103),
            "Start must remove obsolete v1.0.3 panel");
        verify(!BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnStartup(
            "net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspwiregrabber.KspWireGrabberOverlay"),
            "Unrelated plugins must never be touched");
        verify(!BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnStartup(null),
            "Null overlay names are not Bond Goal");

        // After a new plugin starts, a delayed old-plugin shutdown
        // may arrive. It must not remove the new plugin's overlay.
        verify(!BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnShutdown(staleV102, false),
            "An obsolete plugin may not remove the current owner's overlay");
        verify(BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnShutdown(BOND_GOAL_OVERLAY, true),
            "Disabling Bond Goal must remove the plugin-owned overlay");
        verify(!BondGoalOverlayLifecycle.removeOnShutdown(
            "net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspaiofighter.KspAioFighterPaint", true),
            "Shutdown must not remove another plugin's overlay");

        System.out.println("PASS: duplicate cleanup on startup and owner-safe shutdown");
    }
}
